description: Distress alert with repetition. Included as a vector because severity decoding is the one field where a corrupted byte could change behaviour dangerously.

negativeCases.reason: An unknown severity must degrade downward. A corrupted byte must never be able to trigger the loudest, non-interruptible announcement.
Language tags are validated against ^[a-z]{2}-[A-Z]{2}$ so an unmatched tag cannot select an arbitrary voice pack.
